name: claim-autofill-extension
description: Chrome extension that fills approved amounts from claim amounts and audits RGHS bundled packages for unbundling

scripts.test:hosting: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only hosting "node scripts/hosting-smoke.js" --project claimextension
scripts.check: python tools/validate-matrix-coverage.py && node tools/check-no-secrets.js && node --check tools/bootstrap-production-admin.js && node --check build.js && node --check audit-rules.js && node --check custom-rules.js && node --check processing-rules.js && node --check audit-core.js && node --check auth-core.js && node --check claim-core.js && node --check review-core.js && node --check content.js && node --check background.js && node --check options.js && node --check floating-widget.js && node --check popup.js && node --check hosting/firebase-client.js && node --check hosting/admin.js && node --check scripts/hosting-smoke.js && node --check scripts/staging-smoke.js && node --check scripts/live-browser-smoke.js && node --check scripts/browser-smoke-e2e.js && node --check scripts/license-lifecycle-acceptance.js && node --check scripts/run-lifecycle-emulators.js && node --check scripts/release.js && node --check scripts/verify-artifact.js && node --test "tests/*.test.js"
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch . --ignore dist --ignore tests -e js,html,css,json --exec npm run build
